marble.name: Cloud Types
marble.subject: Science
marble.description: Identify the three main cloud types — cumulus (fluffy, fair weather), stratus (flat layers, overcast or drizzle), and cirrus (thin wisps, high up) — and understand that clouds form as water vapour in the air cools, forming tiny water droplets or ice crystals
marble.prompt: If you looked up at the sky, could they identify whether the clouds are fluffy cumulus, flat stratus, or wispy cirrus, and explain that clouds are made of tiny water droplets or ice crystals?

cluster.summary: Your child is discovering how weather works — learning about different types of weather, how to stay safe during storms, and understanding how weather patterns change with the seasons.

misconceptions: Clouds are made of water vapour or gas — visible clouds are tiny LIQUID (or ice) droplets; vapour is invisible
Steam is water vapour — it is condensed liquid droplets too
In a cloud-in-a-jar demo, the smoke IS the cloud — the smoke provides particles for droplets to condense on
Clouds are solid/fluffy things you could stand on, rather than suspended droplets
All clouds mean rain — many (cumulus, cirrus) are fair-weather or high-and-dry
representations: Altitude-layered sky diagram placing cirrus high, cumulus/stratus lower
Photo field-guide cards pairing each cloud with its name and typical weather
A cooling-air panel showing vapour condensing onto particles into droplets
A simple cloud → forecast lookup (fluffy = fair; grey layer = drizzle; high wisps = change coming)
authoredAnswer: A cloud is made of tiny water droplets (and sometimes ice crystals) formed when water vapour cools and condenses. The tall, dark, piled-up cloud is far more likely to bring rain soon than the thin, high, wispy streaks.

wrongAnswers.wrong: A cloud is fluffy cotton-like stuff, not water.
wrongAnswers.fix: Link kettle-steam and breath-on-cold-glass to droplets condensing from vapour.

wrongAnswers.wrong: Any cloud in the sky means it will rain.
wrongAnswers.revealedBy: cannot tell rain clouds from fair-weather clouds
wrongAnswers.fix: Sort cloud photos by the weather each type brings.

wrongAnswers.wrong: A cloud is the water vapour, which is why we can see it.
wrongAnswers.revealedBy: says the visible cloud is vapour
wrongAnswers.fix: Stress vapour is invisible; the visible cloud is liquid droplets.
